title: Companion heart-to-heart
description: A drover joins the party, then the player talks to her by the fire about what she wants and fears. Companion-mode turns after the first.

steps.say: I ask Tamsin, a young drover heading the same way, to travel with me. She agrees.
Tamsin, why are you really on this road? You don't look like someone chasing herd money.
Tamsin, if it goes bad at the coast, what do you want me to do?
